name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
summary_text: Saint Kitts and Nevis demands real caution. Part of the Eastern Caribbean decriminalisation wave (2022 court ruling); tiny population, tourist economy, no documented anti-trans violence pattern; no LGR.

sources.claim_summary: NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust page documents Eastern Caribbean constitutional challenges; Saint Kitts and Nevis decriminalised same-sex conduct in 2022 via such a challenge.

sources.title: Antigua and Barbuda: High Court Decriminalizes Gay Sex | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This HRW article is about Antigua and Barbuda's 2022 ruling, not Saint Kitts and Nevis specifically; included as Eastern Caribbean regional context (St Kitts decriminalised the same year).

Nation News (Aug 2022): the Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court struck down anti-buggery laws - the ruling covering Saint Kitts and Nevis (Jamal Jeffers v Attorney General) decriminalised consensual same-sex conduct.
The Advocates for Human Rights international submissions index page for Saint Kitts and Nevis - navigation/landing page linking to their UN advocacy submissions.

sources.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis | Outright International
sources.claim_summary: Outright International country overview for Saint Kitts and Nevis (updated March 2026): decriminalised in 2022 via Jamal Jeffers et al. v The Attorney General - Sections 56 and 57 of the Offences Against the Person Act contravened constitutional privacy and expression rights; no legal gender recognition; no non-discrimination laws.

Saint Kitts and Nevis Alliance + ECADE UPR presentation (2025): decriminalisation in 2022 after civil-society court challenge; LGBTQ+ citizens included in the National Gender Equality Policy 2022-2027 but 'lack of tangible steps by the State'; discrimination in workplace, education, accommodation and hate speech still not illegal; LGBTQ+ people avoid law enforcement.
